standard_prerequisites.name: Pullback of a flat module is flat and Tor vanishes over flat modules
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Stacks Project, Modules on Sites, Lemmas lemma-pullback-flat (tag 09BI) and lemma-flat-tor-zero (tag 09B8)
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the two inputs that keep exactness under tensoring with the structure sheaf.

core_obligations: Use exactness of f^{-1} to obtain the short exact sequence of f^{-1}O-modules 0 -> f^{-1}F -> f^{-1}G -> f^{-1}H -> 0 (proof lines 7601-7604).
Use that the pullback of a flat module is flat, and the vanishing of Tor over a flat module, to conclude that tensoring this sequence over f^{-1}O with O' remains exact (proof lines 7604-7608).
Identify f^* of each term with the corresponding tensor product and conclude that the pulled-back sequence is short exact (proof lines 7609-7611).
proof_roadmap: Apply exactness of the inverse image.
Use flatness of the pulled-back quotient and Tor vanishing.
Read off exactness of the pullback sequence.
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that pullback along a morphism of ringed topoi preserves a short exact sequence of modules whose third term is flat. The proof applies exactness of the inverse image to get a short exact sequence of modules over the pulled-back structure sheaf, uses that the pullback of a flat module is flat, and then invokes the vanishing of Tor over a flat module to conclude that tensoring the sequence with the structure sheaf of the source remains exact; since the pullback is by definition that tensor product, the conclusion follows (proof lines 7600-7611). H2: the reduction of exactness after pullback to exactness after tensoring over the pulled-back structure sheaf, using flatness, is the substance.
